{{Quote|Take these charges and put them on the turbines. I'll go line the support beams. Set timers for thirty minutes. That ought to be enough for us to get clear and meet Kishpaugh at the rendezvous point.|[[Ghost (clone trooper)|Ghost]], to [[Banks (clone)|Banks]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within">''[[The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within]]''</ref>}}
An '''explosive charge''' was a demolition device. They were sold throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for a hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] apiece, although the sale was restricted and required appropriate licenses.
